1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.

Petitioners seek quashing of case FIR No. 662/2024 of PS Bhajanpura for offence under Section 498A/406/34 IPC and Section 3 & 4 Dowry Prohibition Act on the ground that the complainant de facto (respondent no.2) has compromised the disputes with the petitioners.
3. Learned ASC accepts notice and seeks and is allowed four weeks to file status report.
This is a digitally signed order.

Respondent no. 2 identified by Inspector Mousam Ghani also accepts notice.
5. It is pointed out by learned ASC that parties have not placed on record any written settlement deed.

Parties have agreed to a full and final settlement amount of Rs.45,00,000/- to be paid by petitioners to respondent no. 2 towards all her past, present and future claims including stridhan,
